newsitem.title: UK: Flemings launches weekly funds data weekly book.
newsitem.headline: Flemings launches weekly funds data weekly book.

text.p: Flemings Research has launched a new weekly publication giving detailed data backed by a five-year data history on over 400 country funds.

Flemings said the new publication offered performance measurement in rising as well as falling markets, analysis of consistancy of performance, downside risk against upside potential, expense and portfolio turnover ratios and realised and unrealised gains and losses.
Analysis is by country, sector and capitalisation.
It also offers analysis of funds' portfolios, including the percentage in unlisted or illiquid shares and valuation techniques.
